paite: Huchi in nang ka tapa, Khrist Jesu a hehpihna om ah thilhihtheihna nei in om in.
heading: Khrist Jesu Sepaih Hoih

paite: Theihpih tampite lak a ka kam a thu na zakte, mimuanhuai, midangte hilhsawn thei dingte kiang ah kemsak in.
Khrist Jesu sepaih hoih bang in gimthuak hon thuakpih in.
Sepaih a om ding a atelpa kipahsak ahihtheihna ding in, sepaih kuamah kidou lai in hiai damsung khosaknate in akisubuai ngei kei hi.
Huan kidemnate ah mite pang mahleh dan bang a ahihkeileh khuksak in a-om ngei kei hi.
heading: Kimawlmi Leh Louneimi A Pan Sinlai

paite: Louneipa semgim agah tang masapa ahih ding ahi.
Ka thugentak ngaihtuah in; Toupa'n thil tengteng ah theihsiamna ahon pe ding hi.
Jesu Khrist, David suan ka tanchinhoih gen bang a misi lak a kipan a thounawnpa theigige in.
Huai tanchinhoih ziak in thil hihkhialpa bang in hen hial in gimna ka thuak zel hi; himahleh Pathian thu hen in a-om kei hi.
Huaiziak in Khrist Jesu a hotdamna tangtawn a thupina toh amuh sam theihna ding un, telte ziak in bangkim ka thuak hi.
Hiai thugen adik hi: "Asihna a i sih khit ngalleh, ahinna ah i hing ding hi.
I thuak leh avaihawmna ah vai i hawm sam ding hi; amah i kitheihmohbawlleh ama'n leng hon kitheihmohbawl ding.
Eite muanhuai lou in om mah lehang, Amah zaw muanhuai in a-om gige hi; amah-le-amah akitheihmohbawl thei ngal kei a.”
Hiai theisak inla, thute leltak tung a akisellouhna ding un Toupa muh in phatuamngaitak in theisak in; huai kiselna bangmah aphatuam kei a, angaikhete a ding in siatna ahi zaw hi.
heading: Pathian Pomtak Nasemmi

paite: Nasemtu, zumna ding nei lou, thutak thu diktak a zang, Pathian pomtak hi ding a nangmah kipe ding in theihtawp suah in kisin in.
Himahleh Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawkte nungngatsan in; huchibang mite Pathian limsaklouhna lam ah apai gamla semsem ding ua,
athu un meima sia nek bang in ane zel ding; alak uah Himenaias leh Philetas apang uhi.
Huai mite'n thohnawnna a-om khinta chi in thutak lam apialsan ua, mi khenkhatte ginna ahihmangsak uhi.
Himahleh Pathian suangphum kip adingh lai a, hiai chiamtehna anei hi: "Toupa'n ama ate athei," chih leh, "Toupa min lou peuhmah in diktatlouhna paisan hen," chih.

Himahleh inn thupi ah tui-um belsuan dangka-eng leh dangka a bawlte kia a-om kei a, sing leh bellei a bawlte leng a-om hi; khenkhatte manphatak a zat a-om a, khenkhatte manpha lou deuh a zat leng a-om sam hi.
Huaiziak in mi huai thil manphaloute lak a akihepleh tui-um belsuan manphatak a zat ding, siangthou, apu a dia zat tak, nasep hoih chiteng a dia mansa ahi ding hi.
Himahleh valnou duhgawlnate taisan inla, lungtang siangthou a Toupa sam peuhmahte lak adiktatna, ginna, itna leh khamuanna delh in.
Himahleh kidounate asuaksak nak chih thei in, kiselna haihuai leh pil lou ah pang nuam ke'n.
Toupa sikha in adou ding ahi kei a, mi tengteng tung ah siam tum in, thuhilh siam in, gitlouh tung a thuakzou in,
amah doute thunuailuttak in athuhilh zaw ding hỉ. Huchi in Pathian in thutak atheihna ding un akisiksak zenzen kha ding hi,
huchi in khua ahon theithei ding ua, amaute suak-le-sal a man a a-utut a bawlpa diabol thang a kipan asuakta thei ding uh.
